messages:
Maya (marketing): Quick sync  we're aiming to announce next Thursday. Need pinned changelog URL, docs examples, 3 short bench bullets, and a webinar demo owner by EOD Tue. Who can own demo? @Ken?
Ken (eng): I can run the demo. Will show canary rollout + live latency graph. Need stable changelog link and a sample curl that includes X-Prefix-Cache.
Ally (eng): Changelog draft: https://redwood.internal/changelogs/1.9-wip. Added notes about default_batch and canary flag names.
Ruth (docs): I'll add curl+python snippets and a short migration note. Plan to publish at 08:45 PT on release morning so links are live.
Ben (marketing): Marketing wants 3 bullets: p50 delta, token-cost %, and throughput change. Hugo please confirm conservative numbers for the public blurb.
Hugo (product): Use conservative figures: p50 ~40% lower, p95 ~25% lower on common workloads; token cost ~18% lower with cache + dynamic batching. I'll DM the spreadsheet.
Maya (marketing): Webinar time preference: 9am PT release morning. Ken demo, Hugo product narrative, Maya moderate. Need slides + bench CSV.
Ken (eng): Bench CSV is at s3://bench/rls-1739/summary.csv. I'll attach raw CSV to the slides channel. Also will post demo script EOD Tue.
Ben (marketing): Inbound CTA: 'Request a demo' should post utm_campaign=rls-1739 and model_hint fields to sales webhook. Who owns webhook smoke test?
Ken (eng): I'll run the smoke test from staging and paste the curl here.
preflight-bot: Preflight queued  tasks: docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_purge, webhook_smoke_test, webinar_slides. Will post status updates.
Maya (marketing): Final owners: slides (Ben), demo script (Ken), docs publish (Ruth), changelog pin (Ally), webhook test (Ken), bench confirm (Ally). Dry run Sat 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, drop in this thread and tag me.
file_metadata_note: This thread contains coordination for launch announcement: changelog pin, docs publish, bench narrative, webinar planning, and inbound lead webhook tests.
